description: UFW firewall rules audit — Offline audit of Ubuntu UFW firewall output (text= from sudo ufw status verbose or ufw status numbered). Parses status, default policies, logging and every rule (ports, ranges, app profiles like OpenSSH/Nginx Full, interfaces, IPv6, comments), then flags an inactive firewall, default allow incoming/routed, allow-all rules, databases/caches/admin ports open to anywhere (Redis, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Docker API, etcd, kubelet, RDP, SMB...), SSH without ufw limit, wide port ranges, TCP+UDP opened for TCP services, rules shadowed by first-match order (an ALLOW after a DENY that never applies, or the reverse), missing v6 rules and the Docker bypass. Returns EXPOSED/FIX REQUIRED/REVIEW/PASS, score, grade, parsed rules and exact ufw fix commands. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
